selection: all original cases including missing/overflow/quarantine; original roles unchanged; no prediction of quarantine/reserved
measured_pilot: 96 train parents,126 rail-zero waveforms all with acquisition leading/trailing support; ROOT requested12758259 B; 172.307399 CPU s in3 independent runtime startups
admission: run/event identity of RDO and PHYS checked per event; full-acquisition raw sum is deliberately not required to equal finite producer-window raw. Exact original-tool window closure is separate pilot and is not used to change X/cuts
status: frozen before new energy outcomes for saturation or timing

features.SaturationValid: per3 downstream channel: ADC present, rail flag, two-edge support, recovery available
features.Saturation: valid controls plus same-W recoveredQ, profile lower/upper widths, rail count, nonclipped residual/mismatch. Raw62 preserved; invalid recovery NaN
features.TimingValid: strict status0 both, finite nonnegative times and physically present ADC; all events retained
features.Timing: valid controls plus calibrated fixedpair residuals only after independent mu-control calibration
features.Depth: full-support Z oracle already separately frozen; material and deployment representation gated by actual geometry/covariance

recovery_policy.window: actual official conditions window verified in original-tool pilot; no arbitrary absolute ADC bins
recovery_policy.template: perchannel/run train-only real unsaturated status0 pulse template; pooledchannel fallback minimum50; mean plus2 shape PCs, coefficients within3trainingSD; fixed translation nuisance
recovery_policy.noise: baseline correlated covariance; GLS of observed edge and simultaneous one-sided Gaussian bounds for censored samples, not product of independent probabilities
recovery_policy.uncertainty: profile objective set and source/cal empirical coverage; unavailable or unbounded stays missing, no arbitrary Qcap
recovery_policy.augmentation: retain observed nonclipped samples and raw features; recover only missing top; no nonzero-status arrival-time feature
